name: flow-field
title: Flow Field
description: A full-bleed canvas of hundreds of particle trails that flow left to right like wind. Moving the pointer bends the streams around it and sheds small vortices, while a click sends a ripple outward.
use: A dark hero or section wants a calm animated field that reacts to the pointer without stealing focus.
avoid: The page must stay cheap on mobile or low-power devices; it runs a full canvas loop of hundreds of particles.
a11y: The canvas is aria-hidden and decorative; reduced motion is handled by drawing a still field instead of the loop. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A near-black full-bleed surface covered in fine, faint grey streaks all running roughly left to right. Over the centre sit a small pill, a large white headline and a muted paragraph.
behaves: The trails drift continuously and part around the cursor, shedding small swirling vortices as it moves; a click pushes a ring of air outward. Off screen or under reduced motion it draws a still field and stops the loop.
customise: Set density, speed and interactivity as props, and pass children to overlay copy on the wind. Colours follow the canvas text colour, so a theme class changes them.
weight: heavy: Up to 700 particle trails drawn to canvas every animation frame, with a reduced idle rate.
